```{r}
params_of_inter = c("E_init", "I_init", "H_init", "CH_init",
                    "gamma", "nu", "epsilon", 
                    "rho_gene", "sigma_ww", "sigma_hosp_prev", "sigma_hosp_inc")
param_trace_plot = raw_gq %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(chain, iteration)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    name %in% params_of_inter
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    name = factor(
      name,
      levels = params_of_inter
    ),
    chain = factor(chain)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = iteration,
      y = value,
      color = chain
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("fishualize::Acanthurus_coeruleus") +
  facet_wrap(
    .~name,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Sample",
    x = "Iteration",
    color = "Chain"
  ) +
  custom_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text()
  )
param_trace_plot
```

```{r}
param_effective_samp_size = raw_gq %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(chain, iteration)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    name %in% params_of_inter
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Parameter = factor(
      name,
      levels = params_of_inter
    ),
    Chain = factor(chain)
  ) %>%
  select(-chain, -name) %>%
  group_by(Chain, Parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    `Effective Sample Size` = ess(value)
  ) %>%
  formattable(
    list(
      `Effective Sample Size` = formatter(
        "span", 
        style = x ~ ifelse(
          x > 200, #Generally arbitrary (trace plots reaching convergence) 
          "color: green;", 
          "color: red;"
        )
      )
    )
  )
param_effective_samp_size
```
```{r}
acf_plots = raw_gq %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(chain, iteration)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    name %in% params_of_inter
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    name = factor(
      name,
      levels = params_of_inter
    ),
    chain = factor(chain)
  ) %>%
  group_by(chain, name) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    acf_result = map(data, ~ acf(.x$value, plot = FALSE)),
    acf_data = map(acf_result, ~ data.frame(
      lag = .$lag, 
      acf = .$acf, 
      ci = qnorm(0.975) / sqrt(.$n.used)
    ))
  ) %>%
  unnest(acf_data) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = lag, 
      y = acf, 
      color = chain
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.1, 
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -0.1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      xend = lag, 
      yend = 0
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("fishualize::Acanthurus_coeruleus") +
  facet_wrap(
    .~name, 
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Lag", 
    y = "ACF"
  ) +
  custom_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(),
  )
acf_plots
```

```{r}
gq %>%
  select(-iteration, -chain) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -bayes
  ) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(name, "rt_vals") | str_detect(name, "w_t")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    obstime = str_extract(
      name, 
      "(?<=\\[)\\d+(?=\\])"
    ),
    obstime = as.numeric(obstime),
    param = str_extract(name, "^[^\\[]+")
  ) %>% 
  select(
    bayes, obstime, param, value
  ) %>%
  group_by(bayes, obstime, param) %>%
  summarize(
    lower_50th = quantile(value, 0.25),
    lower_80th = quantile(value, 0.1),
    lower_95th = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper_50th = quantile(value, 0.75),
    upper_80th = quantile(value, 0.9),
    upper_95th = quantile(value, 0.975),
    median = median(value)
  ) %>%
  slice(rep(row_number(), 7)) %>%
  arrange(
    obstime
  ) %>%
  filter(
    obstime != 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(bayes, param) %>%
  mutate(
    obstime = row_number(),
    param = case_when(
      param == "rt_vals" ~ "Effective Reproduction Number",
      param == "w_t" ~ "Hospitalization Probability"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    obstime <= 89
  ) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = ifelse(param == "Effective Reproduction Number", 1, NA)),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      x = obstime,
      ymin = lower_95th,
      ymax = upper_95th,
      fill = bayes
    ),
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df %>%
      mutate(param = "Effective Reproduction Number") %>%
      filter(obstimes <= 89),
    aes(
      x = obstimes,
      y = rt,
      color = " "
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(
      yintercept = ifelse(param == "Hospitalization Probability", .35, NA),
      color = "red",
      linetype="dashed"
    )
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      x = obstime,
      ymin = lower_95th,
      ymax = upper_95th,
      fill = bayes
    ),
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df %>%
      mutate(param = "Hospitalization Probability") %>%
      filter(obstimes <= 89),
    aes(
      x = obstimes,
      y = wt,
      color = " "
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c(" "),
    values = c("black")
  ) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("fishualize::Acanthurus_coeruleus") +
  facet_wrap(
    param~.,
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Time-varying Parameter",
    x = "Time",
    fill = "Distribution Type - 95th QI",
    color = "Obs Data"
  ) +
  custom_theme +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text())
```

```{r}
subset_ode_df = gq %>%
  filter(
    bayes == "Posterior"
  ) %>%
  select(-iteration, -chain, -bayes) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything()
  ) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(name, "^I\\[\\d+\\]$") | 
      str_detect(name, "^E\\[\\d+\\]$") | 
      str_detect(name, "^H\\[\\d+\\]$")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    obstime = str_extract(name, "(?<=\\[)\\d+(?=\\])"),
    obstime = as.numeric(obstime),
    ode_curve = str_extract(name, "^[^\\[]+")
  ) %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  group_by(obstime, ode_curve) %>%
  summarize(
    lower_50th = quantile(value, 0.25),
    lower_80th = quantile(value, 0.1),
    lower_95th = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper_50th = quantile(value, 0.75),
    upper_80th = quantile(value, 0.9),
    upper_95th = quantile(value, 0.975),
    median = median(value)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    as.numeric(obstime)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = "EIHR-h-ww"
  )
subset_ode_df
```

```{r}
## Latent Curves - ODE Solutions
subset_ode_df = gq %>%
  filter(
    bayes == "Posterior"
  ) %>%
  select(-iteration, -chain, -bayes) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything()
  ) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(name, "^I\\[\\d+\\]$") | 
      str_detect(name, "^E\\[\\d+\\]$") | 
      str_detect(name, "^H\\[\\d+\\]$")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    obstime = str_extract(name, "(?<=\\[)\\d+(?=\\])"),
    obstime = as.numeric(obstime),
    ode_curve = str_extract(name, "^[^\\[]+")
  ) %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  group_by(obstime, ode_curve) %>%
  summarize(
    lower_50th = quantile(value, 0.25),
    lower_80th = quantile(value, 0.1),
    lower_95th = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper_50th = quantile(value, 0.75),
    upper_80th = quantile(value, 0.9),
    upper_95th = quantile(value, 0.975),
    median = median(value)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    as.numeric(obstime)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = "EIHR-h-ww"
  )%>%
  group_by(ode_curve, model) %>%
  mutate(
    date = c(
      df$dates[1:83],
      seq.Date(
        from = as.Date("2026-10-22"), 
        to = as.Date("2026-11-11"), 
        by = "day"
      )
    )
  )

ode_plot = ggplot(subset_ode_df) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      x = date,
      ymin = lower_50th,
      ymax = upper_50th,
      fill = model
    ),
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      x = date,
      ymin = lower_80th,
      ymax = upper_80th,
      fill = model
    ),
    alpha = 0.25,
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      x = date,
      ymin = lower_95th,
      ymax = upper_95th,
      fill = model
    ),
    alpha = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = median,
      color = model
    ),
  ) +
  # geom_vline(
  #   xintercept = as.Date("2025-02-26"),
  #   linetype = "dashed"
  # ) +
  scale_x_date( 
    date_breaks = "1 month", 
    date_labels =  "%b %Y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c("EIHR-h-ww", "EIHR-h"),
    values = c("dodgerblue", "salmon")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("EIHR-h-ww", "EIHR-h"),
    values = c("dodgerblue", "salmon")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ode_curve~.,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  expand_limits(
    y = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ODE Cruves for E, I, H Compartments",
    y = "Compartment Count",
    x = "Date",
    fill = "Model",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
```

```{r}
## Posterior Predictives - Wastewater
ww_pp_plot = raw_pp %>%
  select(-iteration, -chain) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything()
  ) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(name, "data_wastewater")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    obstime = str_extract(
      name, 
      "(?<=\\[)\\d+(?=\\])"
    ),
    obstime = as.numeric(obstime)
  ) %>%
  select(
    -name
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    obstime
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    lower_50th = quantile(value, 0.25),
    lower_80th = quantile(value, 0.1),
    lower_95th = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper_50th = quantile(value, 0.75),
    upper_80th = quantile(value, 0.9),
    upper_95th = quantile(value, 0.975),
    median = median(value)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    as.numeric(obstime)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    date = c(
      df$dates[1:83],
      seq.Date(
        from = as.Date("2026-10-22"), 
        to = as.Date("2026-11-11"), 
        by = "day"
      )
    ),
    model = "EIHR-inc-prev-ww"
  ) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      x = date,
      ymin = lower_95th,
      ymax = upper_95th,
      fill = model
    ),
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = median,
      color = model
    ),
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df,
    aes(
      x = dates,
      y = log_ww_conc
    ),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df,
    aes(
      x = dates,
      y = log_ww_conc,
      shape = "Fit"
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df,
    aes(
      x = dates,
      y = log_ww_conc,
      shape = "Fit"
    ),
    color = "red",
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  # geom_vline(
  #   xintercept = as.Date("2026-10-06"),
  #   linetype = "dashed"
  # ) +
  scale_x_date( 
    date_breaks = "1 month", 
    date_labels =  "%b %Y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c("EIHR-inc-prev-ww"),
    values = c("dodgerblue")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("EIHR-inc-prev-ww"),
    values = c("dodgerblue")
  ) +
  # scale_shape_manual(
  #   breaks = c("Fit", "Forecast"),
  #   values = c(16, 1)
  # ) +
  labs(
    title = "Viral RNA Conc.",
    y = "Log Conc",
    x = "Date",
    fill = "Model",
    color = "Model",
    shape = "Period"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    #axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1),
    #axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    #plot.background = element_rect(fill = "whitesmoke"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 18)
  )
ww_pp_plot
```
